kit_status.Venus kit: carried; fit and deploy demonstrated for B4-S only
kit_status.rover kit (when not in core): carried from Wayfarer; fit demonstrated for B4-S well only

archetypes.name: Long reach
archetypes.why: most crossrange from orbit (pick the landing zone late)

archetypes.name: Light courier
archetypes.why: least mass on Wayfarer (dry + full water), still does Earth

archetypes.name: Hot extraction
archetypes.why: hot egress to orbit with the sprint kit, then turn and reach

archetypes.name: All-rounder
archetypes.why: most capabilities, then reach and light

archetypes.name: #2643 (study lead)
archetypes.why: best corrected conventional (misses evacuation by 0.1 m/s); with the Osteon wildcard it passes all five from cautious to optimistic. Try: Edit a copy → Tech wildcard

archetypes.name: Compact sea courier
archetypes.why: new family: no wings, fans + sea refill; lightest 6-couch design passing Earth, orbital and surface missions

archetypes.name: Eight-couch sea courier
archetypes.why: 8 couches with folding wings; passes Earth, orbital and surface missions at 55 t on Wayfarer

gate_sources.Bay fit radius (stowed hull only): F-series envelope r 2.15 m; folded wings/fans/floats, 3.8 m slot, roll and G8 exit path NOT checked
gate_sources.Dry mass: kT reserve share ceiling 52.5 t; masses scaled from B4-S parts
gate_sources.Interior: usable vs allocated: allocations 3.5 m3/couch (hops), rover 11.5 + door 5 (else cargo well 6), aft 7, avionics 3, desal 0.5
gate_sources.Light water landing (2 m waves): kT landing rule 2026-11-21: light landings in 2 m waves at 30-36, US-2 class [threshold]; blown-flap CL rule is an assumed line through one QSRA-class point
gate_sources.Heavy water landing (~1 m waves): kT landing rule 2026-11-21: heavy ~50 m/s in ~1 m waves [threshold]
gate_sources.Venus water vs tank + kit water: Venus kit carries up to ~13 t extra water (step 2 estimate 8-13 t) [assumption]
gate_sources.Moon water (vacuum kit) vs tank: vacuum-kit dry = core - wings - floats - fans - half TPS + 1.5 t (assumed)

land_light_ms: kT landing rule 2026-11-21: light landings in 2 m waves at 30-36, US-2 class [threshold]
land_heavy_ms: kT landing rule 2026-11-21: heavy ~50 m/s in ~1 m waves [threshold]
venus_kit_water_t: Venus kit carries up to ~13 t extra water (step 2 estimate 8-13 t) [assumption]

missions.status: ASSUMPTIONS for exploration only. Not requirements, not canon. Every number is editable in the explorer. Earth return may refill from the sea (kT 2026-11-21); evacuation and hot extraction assume no time to refill (editable).

earth.note: step2 R1: deorbit, land, climb at T/W 1.4, rendezvous

hard20.note: R1 with a hard climb-out at T/W 2.0 for the first 3 km/s

hard25.note: R1 with a hard climb-out at T/W 2.5 for the first 3 km/s

orbital.note: orbit-to-orbit transfers, 4 km/s total at low thrust (ASSUMPTION)

rover_kit_t.note: B4-S light rover parts (chassis 0.973 + shell 0.258 + outfit 0.6), carried from Wayfarer when not in the core
